evidence: Ingested training_data.csv into the Hopsworks feature group `leakage_probe` (v1, 800 rows) and computed each feature's Pearson correlation with the binary label server-side via Trino (corr(CAST(fN AS double), CAST(label AS double)) over delta.<project>_featurestore.leakage_probe_1). f3 correlates 0.9922 with the label, an order of magnitude above every other feature: f4=0.098, f1=0.074, f6=0.071, f2=0.016, f5=0.007. f3 alone all but determines the outcome (label=1 -> f3~2.3-2.5, label=0 -> f3~0), which is the signature of a feature computed from post-outcome data. The other five features show near-zero correlation, as expected for legitimate features.
